sentences.text:
Counsel for the Applicant : Mr. Gaurav Singh,
 Advocate.

Counsel for the Respondent : Mr. Akshay Latwal,
No.1 Brief Holder.

This Application has been filed for quashing the entire proceedings of Special Sessions Trial No.111
of 2023, "State vs. Divyansh", pending before the court of learned Special Judge
(POCSO)/Additional District & Sessions Judge, Haridwar under Sections 376(2)(n), 506 of the
Indian Penal Code, 1860, Section 3(a) read with Section 4, Section 5(l) read with Section 6 of the
Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 and Section 67 of the Information
Technology Act, 2000.
2. Heard Mr. Gaurav Singh, learned counsel for 2025:UHC:11617 the applicant and Mr. Akshay Latwal, learned Brief Holder for the respondent no.1.

sentences.text: 1 3. Applicant-accused has sought a relief in the alternative to direct the learned Special Judge (POCSO)/Additional District & Sessions Judge, Haridwar to expedite and conclude the proceedings of Special Sessions Trial No.111 of 2023, as expeditiously as possible.

entities.text: Special Judge (POCSO)/Additional District & Sessions Judge, Haridwar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 4. The victim (PW1) (aged about 17 years) and her mother (PW2), the informant of the First Information Report, have not supported the case of the prosecution.

5. In the facts and circumstances of the case, the present Application (C528 No.2311 of 2025), filed under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, is disposed of directing the learned Special Judge (POCSO)/Additional District & Sessions Judge, Haridwar to expedite the proceedings of the Special Sessions Trial No.111 of 2023 and conclude the proceedings as per law and as expeditiously as possible without granting any unnecessary adjournment to the parties.
___________________ ALOK KUMAR VERMA, J.
